_comment: MCP servers are OPTIONAL. CCM works without them. Each entry below is a stub — set the corresponding env var to activate. Skills that depend on these MCPs degrade gracefully (arib-memory-search falls back to grep on memory/*.md when claude-mem is unavailable, etc.). Package names are placeholders — verify and update when wiring against real upstream packages.

claude-mem._purpose: Item #3 — semantic memory layer. Falls back to markdown grep if absent.

cowork._purpose: Item #4 — push-based I/O transport. Falls back to filesystem polling.

testsprite._purpose: Item #9 — cloud test execution gate. arib-check-deploy degrades to local checks if absent.
